dialogues.original: Trick or treat! I'm a vampire!
Thank you! My mom made it for me!

choices.answer: She did a wonderful job. What's your favorite candy?
That's sweet. Ready for your treat?

dialogues.original: Thanks! I've been practicing my scary face all week!

choices.answer: Well it's working! Let me see it again.
I bet you have. What candy do you like?

dialogues.original: But... but I am real! I'm 347 years old!

choices.answer: Oh really? Then what was Halloween like in the 1600s?
Sure you are, sweetie. Want some candy?

dialogues.original: Anything with blood... I mean, RED! Anything red!

choices.answer: Blood? That's an interesting choice of words...

dialogues.original: Yes please! This is my last house!

choices.answer: Wait, let me ask you something first...
Very impressive! Those look so real!

dialogues.original: Uh... we didn't have candy back then! Just... blood! I mean BEETS!
I just really like the color! It's my favorite!
Okay... what do you want to know?

choices.answer: Can you come in for some cookies?

dialogues.original: Thanks! My dentist says they're very healthy!
N-no! They're fake! Totally fake! Very fake!

choices.answer: If you say so... here's candy!

dialogues.original: I... I can't! My mom says I can't go into stranger's houses!

choices.answer: Smart mom! Here's your candy then.
Or is it because you're a vampire?
